landing.heroTitle: Earn money by registering Kosovo's businesses
landing.heroText: KS Data is the portal for runners: register local businesses with photos, address and contact details — you earn €0.50 for every approved entry.
landing.how1Text: Create a free account with your email.
landing.how2Text: Name, category, city, contact and photos — straight from your phone.
landing.how3Text: Once approved, the amount is credited to your account and paid out by bank transfer.

ff.claimWhy1: Opening hours, phone, photos and products — you manage them directly, without waiting for anyone.
ff.claimWhy2: Verified businesses get the badge and rank higher in lists and search.
ff.claimWhy3: Requests and reviews reach you directly — and you reply.
ff.claimStep1: Fill in the form and upload two documents: business registration and an ID document.
ff.claimStep2: We verify them — usually within 1–2 business days, sometimes with a verification call.
ff.claimStep3: Once approved, the business appears under “Biznesi im” and you can manage it.
ff.claimPrivacy: Documents are stored privately, seen only by our verification team and deleted automatically after the decision.
